parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift' in the Wallpaper package — a path that contains 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp', which is a sample-app context. The canonical copy resides in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugHUD.swift' (DebugPanel package). The sample app almost certainly copied or re-implemented MetricRow.body locally to remain self-contained and avoid a hard dependency on the DebugPanel package, which is the standard pattern for example/sample targets. Consolidating the two would couple the sample app to the production DebugPanel module, undermining its illustrative independence.
